blockers.issue: Distributed authority checks inventory root uniqueness but not row-dictionary uniqueness. Duplicate saved-row keys can authenticate an ambiguous membership record.
blockers.required_change: Reject duplicates in relevant list/legacy row dictionaries in distributed reader only; preserve old local reader; add focused negative controls.

limits: Source review only; no build, Java, runtime or original-profile access.
One already-admitted peer, at most 64 values versus original 256; explicitly partial, not a global average.
Explicit saved Public selection only; no Host/default/public bootstrap or automatic publication activation.
ANON0x10 is the original flag, not an anonymous-routing guarantee.
Current source is last observed at existing worker fences; no instantaneous filesystem monitoring.
Fresh profile validation and version fsync remain synchronous on network owner.
